scripts.start:tauri: AGENTS=2 BOOTSTRAP_PORT=$(port) SIGNAL_PORT=$BOOTSTRAP_PORT npm run network:tauri
scripts.start:electron: AGENTS=2 BOOTSTRAP_PORT=$(port) SIGNAL_PORT=$BOOTSTRAP_PORT npm run network:electron
scripts.network:tauri: hc s clean && npm run build:happ && INTERNAL_IP=$(internal-ip --ipv4) concurrently -k "npm run local-services" "UI_PORT=1420 npm run -w ui start" "npm run launch:tauri"
scripts.network:electron: hc s clean && npm run build:happ && INTERNAL_IP=$(internal-ip --ipv4) concurrently -k "UI_PORT=1420 npm run -w ui start" "npm run launch:electron"
scripts.launch:moss: npm run build:happ && concurrently "npm start -w ui" "sleep 1 && unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE && weave --agent-idx 1 --dev-config we_dev/config.ts" "sleep 10 && unset ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE && weave --agent-idx 2 --dev-config we_dev/config.ts"
scripts.test: npm run build:zomes && hc app pack workdir --recursive && npm t -w tests
scripts.package: npm run build:happ && npm run package -w ui && hc web-app pack workdir --recursive
scripts.build:happ: npm run build:zomes && hc app pack workdir --recursive
scripts.build:zomes: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target RUSTFLAGS='--cfg getrandom_backend="custom"' cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --workspace --exclude glassbeadgame-tauri
